description: List instances. Filter: all (default) | public | my | my_admin. public lists an instance that has public reading on, is listed in Discover, is not frozen, and has a workspace that is not private holding a page that is not private. my and my_admin list the caller's own instances (member; admin) with no such gate; all is public plus my. Without a token every filter is public.
name: discovery.list_instances
